relationships.subject: pregabalin
relationships.evidence_quote: Oral administration of pregabalin (0.3–30 mg/kg) produced a robust, dose-dependent increase in mechanical withdrawal thresholds in rats subjected to L5–L6 spinal nerve ligation

relationships.subject: pregabalin
relationships.evidence_quote: Pregabalin, a ligand at the α2δ-1 subunit of voltage-gated calcium channels, is a mainstay in the treatment of neuropathic pain.

relationships.subject: thioctic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: modulates TRPV1 channels by reducing their activity and expression through antioxidant and NF-κB–dependent mechanisms

key_findings: Pregabalin (ED50 2.45 mg/kg) and thioctic acid (ED50 57.49 mg/kg) each produced dose-dependent antiallodynia in female rats after L5-L6 spinal nerve ligation.
The 1:1 combination was synergistic by isobolographic analysis (interaction index 0.524) without overt adverse effects.
